desc: Ideation: weighted interval scheduling DP with k≤4, strict non-overlap (r_prev < l_i), lexicographic tie-break on sorted index tuples
Implement: parse intervals, attach original index, sort by (r, l); compute p[i] = bisect_left(rights, l_i)
Implement DP: dp[i][k] = (weight, tuple) with skip/take transitions; keep tuples sorted ascending; comparison helper: higher weight, then smaller tuple
Final answer = best among dp[n][0..4]; return as list

Test: both provided examples; single interval; all-overlapping with weight ties (expect smallest index); equal-weight different-cardinality tie (shorter prefix list wins); chain of exactly 4; boundary-touching overlap (r == l); 300-case random fuzz vs brute force
